notes: Programme page: the DAAD record (English) and the THI programme page (German) both describe this Bachelor. Duration 7 semesters = 3.5 years; ECTS 210 confirms this. Teaching language English; elective subjects can be chosen in German and the Bachelor's thesis can be written in German, but the programme is taught in English. Tuition: the DAAD page says non-EU applicants pay 800 EUR per semester; the THI Studiengebuehren page states 800 EUR per semester for Bachelor students from third countries (from summer semester 2026) - stored as a semester period amount. The THI fee page lists exemptions (e.g. German-equivalent, EU/EEA), but these do not apply to a Moroccan applicant. Application channel: no page states uni-assist or a VPD for a foreign-diploma applicant to this programme; the DAAD page only mentions a possible uni-assist fee ('Apart from the uni-assist fee, there is no application fee.') and says applicants apply on their own, and the THI page says the application runs online in the THI portal, so de-university-direct was chosen with that quote - the auditor should verify against the 'Bachelorbewerbung aus dem Ausland' page (not supplied). Deadline 15 July 2027 is for the winter semester and is valid for applicants from all countries. English B2 certificate is required with an official language certificate; accepted tests quoted are IELTS Academic 5.5 and TOEFL iBT (before 2026) 72. No document translation was stated, so translationRequired is null. Documents list only those named in the quotes: school-leaving certificate and Hochschulzugangsberechtigung (HZB); further documents (CV, ID, language proof) are said to be required at enrolment but are not quoted for this applicant.
